name: Medical Special Care
source:
The plot revolves around the interaction of the main characters with the personalities in the new hospital where they have recently started working. It also includes their interactions among themselves. You will be able to control the decisions of all three main characters (the husband, Eva, and Karin). From the very first day, the atmosphere of the hospital will affect them, and you will be able to choose how strongly.
